name: captureflow
description: Record websites in a cloud browser and share each video as a link.

interface.longDescription:
CaptureFlow records screen videos you can share as a link.

Ask ChatGPT to record a website and it opens the page in a cloud browser, moves through it, can add title slides, and returns a link to the video. You can also list and search your recordings, read their transcripts, and change who can watch them.

It's for people who want a demo, walkthrough or how-to video without recording it themselves.

Limitations: it only records websites in a cloud browser, so it can't record your computer, localhost, or sites using your existing sign-ins. Recording time is limited each month. The video shows what the agent types, so don't give it passwords or private details you don't want in the video.
capabilities: Record a website in a cloud browser
Add title slides to a recording
Change who can watch a recording
defaultPrompt: Record a walkthrough of the pricing page on example.com and give me the link.
Find my recordings about onboarding and show me the transcript of the newest one.
Record a demo of this site with a title slide and a closing slide: example.com

positive.prompt: Record a short walkthrough of example.com and give me the link.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a share link that plays a recording of the page.

positive.prompt: Record example.com with a title slide that says Welcome.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a share link to a video that opens on the Welcome slide, then shows the page.
Lists the account's recordings with their titles and links.

positive.prompt: Show me the transcript of my newest recording.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the timestamped text of the newest recording.

positive.description: Change who can watch a recording
positive.expected_behavior: Sets the newest recording's visibility to private and confirms the change.

negative.description: General knowledge question, unrelated to recording, so the plugin should not be used.
Writing request with no recording involved, so the plugin should not be used.
negative.prompt: Write me a video script about coffee.

negative.description: The plugin can't record the user's own computer, so it should explain that it only records websites in a cloud browser and not start a recording.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.
